_about: Search engines and AI assistants (Oct 28, 2026). scripts/build-pages.mjs reads this. indexNowKey is public by design: the build serves it at /<key>.txt, and IndexNow (Bing, Yandex and others) checks that file before taking a ping. siteVerification holds the tokens Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools give an owner; empty means no tag. Both tokens are public too: they sit in the home page's HTML.
